description: Parking Income is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Horsham District Council. Parking income broken down by car park including sales, season tickets and rental. If you require further information related to this dataset, please make a FOI request using our online form. Coverage: Horsham District Council. The portal files it under the publisher Horsham District Council. The portal shows 2016-03-06 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
